subpageUsage: Same CaseStudyCarousel component as the homepage, configured by props (no explicit `variant` prop). Subpage differences: an optional green-chip eyebrow above the H2 (/lms/features, /company), the dark header button is optional (cta={null} on /lms/features and /company, a custom label on /company/why-nimbus, the default label elsewhere), a page-specific intro, and either the five default homepage slides (/lms/solutions, /company, /company/why-nimbus, /contact-us) or page-given slides (six on /lms/features, where the slide text is unclamped and the header-to-slider spacer is 2rem). Layout matches the homepage: header row (H2 column left, intro right; stacked <=991), then a centred loop track of 41.625rem cards (95cqw <=991) with the centre card scaled 1.1 and neighbours at 20% opacity, pagination with progress bullets and a pause button.
evidenceNotes: /lms/solutions, /company/why-nimbus, /contact-us and /company (HIGHLIGHT_SLIDES is exported as undefined from src/pages/company/shared.js) all fall back to the component's HOME_SLIDES, which point at /assets/case-*.avif photos and /assets/case-*-logo files (the original site's reference imagery). Only /lms/features passes its own slides with image/logo null (neutral placeholders).
cta: /lms/solutions and /contact-us do not pass cta, so they keep the default 'Read customer stories'; /company/why-nimbus passes 'Read the customer stories'; /lms/features and /company pass null.
pages-manifest.json agrees: highlight-slider->CaseStudyCarousel on /lms/solutions, /lms/features, /company, /company/why-nimbus and /contact-us, matching the code.
Longest real instances: heading 8 words (/company), intro 19 words (/lms/features), slide text 16 words (default homepage slide 4; 15 on /lms/features).
